Why Kindred?

Our mission is to safeguard and provide peace of mind to families from insect bites, stings, and nuisances while striving to offer a familial level of care and customer service.

At Kindred Pest Control, we believe that family always comes first. As a family owned and operated company, we are committed to providing your home with exceptional service — because our customers are truly our family.

We are also deeply rooted in our Houston community. Each year, we proudly take on service projects to give back to those in need — including teaming up with local organizations to tackle hunger among Houston's youth.

  • Eco-friendly technologies — botanically derived pesticides
  • Pet, plant, and family friendly treatments
  • Licensed & protected — Texas Department of Agriculture regulations
  • Fast pest removal — usually scheduled within a day
